section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the objectives and hypotheses of the current study, which aims to investigate the unique contributions of exposure to body-focused and non-body-focused others on college women's body image and eating. The study examines these contributions at both between-persons (over a week) and within-persons (day-to-day and within a day) levels. Hypotheses predict that interactions with non-body-focused others will lead to better body image and eating, while interactions with body-focused others will lead to worse outcomes.
